subject: Withdrawing Mason - relocating to Denver

triage.summary: Derek Paton wants to withdraw his son Mason from the T-Ball squad due to a company relocation to Denver in April and asks whether any of the season fee is refundable for the mid-season exit — a cancellation with an attached refund request, so it needs a human decision.
triage.proposed_action: Route to a human: confirm Mason's withdrawal from the T-Ball squad effective April, refer the mid-season refund request for a human money decision, and log the return of the fundraiser candy box. Reply may only acknowledge receipt and promise a follow-up.

details.topic_priority_note: cancellation takes priority over the refund question

policy_reason: Policy: intent 'cancellation' requires human decision (mid-season cancellations involve refunds and roster spots)
